title: BoundedAcquisitionPlan
description: Canonical fixture JSON for a policy-backed finite plan, not dataclasses.asdict() output. Python steps are InternalAcquisitionStep tuples; JSON uses objects. provider is a non-blank string: the structural PR A contract is provider-neutral, and execution/policy decide support. Cross-field invariants JSON Schema does not encode: step keys are unique; len(steps) cannot exceed maximum_internal_acquisitions; each candidate_limit must fit acquisition_budget; geographic plans (requested_geographic_scope != null) require truthful complete and partial effective scopes; acquisition_budget and maximum_internal_acquisitions remain policy-owned. Concrete Facebook Venezuela partition catalogs belong to OpenSpec PR D and must not appear here as if implemented.

provider.description: Non-blank provider identifier. Not a BERA marketplace enum.

key.description: Non-blank step key. Uniqueness across steps is an application invariant.
